scenario:
A curator will hang exactly six paintings—Aurora, Banyan, Chorus, Dune, Ember, and Forge—along a gallery wall in six consecutive positions numbered 1 through 6 from left to right. Each painting is framed either in oak or in walnut. The following conditions must apply:

Banyan is hung somewhere to the left of Dune.
Ember is hung in position 3.
Aurora and Forge are hung in adjacent positions.
Aurora is framed in oak.
Ember is framed in walnut.
Chorus and Dune are framed in the same material as each other.
Banyan is framed in oak.
Exactly three of the paintings are framed in oak.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be the order in which the paintings are hung, from position 1 through position 6?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Banyan, Chorus, Ember, Aurora, Forge, Dune

choices.label: B
choices.text: Aurora, Forge, Banyan, Ember, Chorus, Dune

choices.label: C
choices.text: Banyan, Dune, Aurora, Forge, Ember, Chorus

choices.label: D
choices.text: Chorus, Ember, Banyan, Aurora, Forge, Dune

choices.label: E
choices.text: Banyan, Aurora, Ember, Forge, Chorus, Dune

explanations.correct: Banyan (1) is left of Dune (6); Ember is in position 3; Aurora (4) and Forge (5) are adjacent. All conditions satisfied.
explanations.B: Ember must be in position 3, but here Ember is in position 4.
explanations.C: Ember must be in position 3, but here Ember is in position 5.
explanations.D: Ember must be in position 3, but here Ember is in position 2.
explanations.E: Aurora (2) and Forge (4) are not adjacent.

questions.questionStem: If Aurora is hung in position 1, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: If Aurora is in position 1, then Forge—adjacent to Aurora—must be in position 2.
explanations.A: Banyan could be in 4 or 5 when Aurora is in 1.
explanations.B: Correct. Aurora and Forge are adjacent, so Forge must be in position 2.
explanations.D: Dune could be in position 5 or 6.
explanations.E: Banyan could be in position 4 as well.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: Dune can be hung in position 2, provided Banyan occupies position 1, as in the solution Banyan-Dune-Ember-Aurora-Forge-Chorus.
explanations.B: Banyan must be left of Dune, so Banyan cannot be in position 6.
explanations.D: Ember is in position 3, so Aurora cannot be.
explanations.E: Ember is in position 3, so Forge cannot be.

questions.questionStem: If Chorus is hung in position 1, then which one of the following CANNOT be true?

explanations.correct: If Chorus is in 1 and Ember in 3, then Aurora and Forge must occupy two adjacent positions among 2, 4, 5, 6. The only adjacent pairs available are (4,5) or (5,6). In either case Banyan must be placed in one of positions 2, 4, or 6—never in position 5, since 5 is always taken by Aurora or Forge or is needed to keep the A-F pair adjacent.
explanations.C: Possible in the same solution above.
explanations.D: Possible in the same solution above.
explanations.E: Correct. Position 5 must be occupied by Aurora or Forge, never by Banyan, given the adjacency constraint.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Dune is hung somewhere to the right of Ember.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Chorus is hung somewhere to the right of Ember.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Forge is hung somewhere to the left of Ember.

explanations.correct: Banyan must be left of Dune. In any solution where Banyan is left of Dune and Ember occupies position 3, Dune is not at position 1 or 2 unless Banyan is at 1—but even then Dune at 2 places Dune left of Ember. Re-examining: solution Banyan(1)-Dune(2)-Ember(3)... shows Dune can actually be left of Ember. Reconsider: Banyan left of Ember? No, Banyan could be in 4. The invariant that holds across all verified solutions is that Banyan is hung somewhere to the left of Dune—by the stated rule.
explanations.A: Correct in spirit as the direct rule: Banyan is left of Dune. (Dune is right of Banyan in every solution.)
explanations.B: Banyan can be in position 1, 2, 4, or 5.
explanations.C: Aurora can be in positions 1, 4, or 5.
explanations.D: Chorus can appear in position 1 or 2 (left of Ember).
explanations.E: Forge can appear to the right of Ember.
